'''Blake Mandalis''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Columbus tournament (17 March)]] on 17 March 2001 with Endor start with Ewoks, according to Brian Sykes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1931">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructedd1931/ what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructed], DeckTech (Brian "Armus" Sykes, 20 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-20-what-do-you-mean-its-not-constructedd1931/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
